message.content:
在標準的德州撲克（Texas Hold'em）中，每位玩家都會被發兩張底牌，所有玩家手中的卡片數量完全相同。  
發牌者（Dealer）只是負責分發卡片並不持有任何額外的牌；他只保留整副牌作為發牌用。  

因此，在這種遊戲規則下，沒有任何一個玩家會比其他人手上持有更多的紙牌。

In standard poker games like Texas Hold'em, each player gets two private cards (hole cards). But the dealer deals community cards to all players. So no one has more than others. But maybe they refer to a scenario where some players have more cards due to being the dealer? Actually, in Texas Hold'em, the dealer does not hold extra cards; all players get same number of hole cards. In other variants like Omaha, each player gets four hole cards. But still equal.

But maybe they ask about a situation where the dealer deals cards to each player and then deals community cards. The dealer might hold the deck but not hold cards. So answer: No one has more cards; all players have equal number of cards. Or if you consider the dealer's role, the dealer doesn't hold cards. So answer: All players have equal number of cards. So answer: No one has more; all players have equal number of cards. Also mention that the dealer may hold the deck but not hold cards.
